My farewell to Vietnam 2019 Beef Noodle Soup at the Ho Chi Minh Airport!.
Dec 2019 • Solo
The Bun Bo Hue or the Beef Noodle Soup Hue Style, which i just have had here, was absolutely delicious. The noodles were cooked just right and the beef slices were cooked well too. The garnishings were all freshly prepared and the soup was very tasty, all in all an almost perfect Bun Bo Hue, at the Ho Chi Minh airport!. My Vietnam Airlines flight from the Ho Chi Minh Airport to Bangkok will only leave at 08.35 hours, on Tuesday 24th december 2019, Vietnam Time (to connect with my Bangkok to Amsterdam KLM direct flight, after a relatively short two hours transit at the Bangkok airport). So i will just have to continue drinking my Pepsi Lights here until the Confetti Restaurant in the Waiting Gallery of the Ho Chi Minh Airport closes at around midnight. In any case, i'll (definitely) be home for Christmas!!!✌✌

Good value for money, but communist country style service
Oct 2016 • Solo
To start with the bad things, service is terrible. Staff will take an eternity to notice you and service will only be slightly friendlier than in Russian Gulag. Furthermore they rarely bring you all menus.

Food is quite good and reasonably priced. I had two beers and two banh mi ( French Vietnamese style baguette sandwich, quiye copious ) for slightly less than 10 $. Make sure they also bring you the menu including banh mi and other Vietnamese food and not only the two more expensive menus.

Place has a decent amount of plugs and WIFI ( a little bit unstable, but they have 3 different one's, so make sure to get the passwords for all 3 from the waiter at once, since you will not see any waiter again for a very long time once you are served )

If i could rate it lower than this i would
Sep 2016 • Couples
Mediocre food and incredibly rude staff. They charged us for wet napkins that they provided with the cutlery. To charge for a napkin is unheard of and to provide it without asking or telling the customer there is a charge is absurd. When we asked the server about it after seeing the bill she was very rude. Raising her voice and refusing to bring a manager over and when the manager came over she told us it was normal in Vietnam. We had been traveling for over a month in Vietnam and it was our second trip here and I've never seen such a charge. So unprofessional and rude. Save yourself money and a headache and go to dominos outside before they start charging you to serve the table as well.
